notes: A confirmed causal interaction is a typed relationship finding, not a Conflict Pydantic object.
Do not turn correlation, co-occurrence, thematic resonance or psychological ambivalence into a causal edge.
MUTUALLY_EXCLUSIVE_ERROR means incompatible under the current approved rules. P11A explores explanations; no unresolved error directly enters P12.
After an approved revision, run a fresh P09/P10. Keep the original candidate_ref in the resolution manifest, not by relabeling the original finding.
candidate_identity_rule: candidate_ref must be the host-canonicalized P09 candidate reference and must be copied exactly; no downstream stage may replace it.
explanation_fallback: P11 when explanation exploration is explicitly declined, P11B=REPAIR_REQUIRED or no acceptable creative hypothesis exists; PENDING_EVIDENCE needs explicit exploration authorization.
temporal_rule: seq is local to each line, not a shared clock. Different entities' seq values alone cannot prove temporal order; require an explicit prerequisite/causal path or shared time evidence. effect_node_refs must include the target_node_id.
